'''Anoon'olan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who held a [[Vice President/Legends|vice-presidential]] postion within the company [[Tangan Industries]]. Tangan tasked Anoon'olan with administering the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Shirkel]] on the Tangan-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iol]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
